verse.verse_2: Those who, when they take by measure from mankind, exact the full,
verse.verse_3: And who, when they measure Unto them or weigh for them, diminish.
verse.verse_4: Imagine such men not that they shall be raised up?
verse.verse_6: A Day whereon mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds?
verse.verse_7: By no means! Verily the record of the ungodly is in Sijjin.
verse.verse_8: And what will make thee know whatsoever the record in Sijjin is?
verse.verse_10: Woe on that Day unto the belviers-
verse.verse_11: Those who belie the Day of Requital.
verse.verse_12: And none belieth it save each trespasser, sinner.
verse.verse_13: And when Our revelations are rehearsed Unto him, she saith:'fables of the ancients!
verse.verse_14: By no means!' Aye! encrusted upon their hearts is that which they have been earning.
verse.verse_15: By no means! Verily on that Day from their Lord they will be shut Out.
verse.verse_16: Then verily they will be roasted into the Scorch.
verse.verse_17: Then it will be said: 'this is that which ye were wont to belie.'
verse.verse_18: By no means! Verily the record of the virtuous shall be in 'Illiyun.
verse.verse_19: And what will make thee know whatsoever the record in Illiyun is?
verse.verse_20: A record of good deeds written.
verse.verse_21: To which bear witness those brought nigh.
verse.verse_22: Verily the virtuous shall be in Delight,
verse.verse_24: Thou wilt recognize in their faces the brightness of delight.
verse.verse_25: They will be given to drink of pure wine, sealed.
verse.verse_26: The seal thereof will be of musk and to this end let the aspirers aspire -
verse.verse_27: And admixture thereof will be Water of Tasnim:
verse.verse_28: A fountain whereof will drink those brought nigh.
verse.verse_29: Veriiy those who have sinned were wont at those who had believed to laugh,
verse.verse_30: And, when they passed them, to wink at each other,
verse.verse_31: And when they returned to their household they returned jesting.
verse.verse_32: And when they saw them, they said: verily these are the strayed ones.
verse.verse_33: Whereas they were not sent over them as watchers.
verse.verse_34: Wherefore Today, those who believed at the infidels are laughing,
verse.verse_36: The infidels have indeed been rewarded for that which they had been doing.
